input: Paired with Alex on the authentication refactor today. We got the token refresh logic working cleanly after two frustrating false starts. Really good session — Alex caught a subtle edge case I'd missed in the expiry window check.
Got pulled into an unplanned two-hour strategy meeting that derailed my entire planned afternoon. Left feeling frustrated and behind on sprint work. Nobody had an agenda.
I've noticed over the past year that I do my clearest thinking in the first 90 minutes after waking, before I check messages or news. Afternoons are better for routine tasks and shallow work.

Finally figured out the right pattern for handling concurrent map access in Go — acquire a write lock only when mutating, use RLock for reads, and never hold the lock across a goroutine boundary. This is now solid mental scaffolding for me.
Need to submit the grant proposal draft to the committee by Friday 5pm. This is a firm external deadline — no extensions available. The proposal covers the distributed inference work.

gold.stated_intent: Submit grant proposal draft to the committee by Friday 5pm.
